title: US threatens to cut Ukraine intelligence, weapons supplies over Russian energy strikes
summary_full: A US official said American negotiators had reminded Kyiv that Washington was providing weapons and intelligence and that Ukraine should not take actions that hurt American consumers. Another source familiar with the matter said the US had threatened to cut intelligence sharing. The Financial Times first reported the threats. A Nato official told CNN on Monday that weapons supplies through PURL were continuing.
